title: Unified Audit Finding
description: ONE schema for every finding across every repo, tool, and audit run. Instance-specific vocabularies (repo names, surfaces) live in the instance config.json and are enforced by tools/validate-ledger.mjs, not hardcoded here. v2 change from v1: repo/surface enums removed (instance-defined); semantics otherwise identical.

id.description: Stable global finding id, e.g. F-0001. Never reused, never renumbered. Assigned at merge time by tools/merge-runs.mjs — staged run files omit it.

taxonomy_id.description: Book rule in LETTER:NUMBER form, e.g. 'A:6'. Must exist in the Book index. The canonical checklist axis.

legacy_flag_id.description: Back-compat: pre-2026-07 'Flag A:6 -finding 28' nomenclature. Provenance only; never assigned to new findings.

surface.description: Where the defect lives. Must be one of the instance config.json surfaces[]. 'cross' spans repos (must set related_findings).

repo.description: Must be one of the instance config.json repos[].

status.description: accepted = intentional, documented posture (e.g. sanctioned dev-stage choice).

claim.description: One sentence: the defect, stated as fact about live code.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the live source proving the claim.

related_findings.description: Other finding ids this links to (frontend<->backend root-cause pairing).

method.description: How it was found/verified. RULE 0: never 'stale-doc'.

adversarially_refuted.description: Did an independent refuter agent fail to disprove it? false = survived refutation.

verified_at.description: ISO date of last live-source verification.

event.description: Lifecycle event. "note" records new evidence on an entry whose status is unchanged — the commonest event in an active audit, and the one whose absence caused 18 ad-hoc event names to be invented on 2026-08-23.
